comparison.objective: Push a forked air-freshener clip fully onto a pivoting vent vane without changing the vent aim.
comparison.physical_skill: Millimeter-scale fork-to-edge alignment, compliant push-on engagement, and disturbance control of a movable support.
comparison.success_condition: Clip is fully engaged, square, released and load-bearing while all vanes remain close to their original aim.
comparison.reason: This is compliant clip installation while preserving support orientation. It does not test loose-body screening, selective retention, or loaded bimanual agitation.
